about: What the critic reads for each kind of picture (SNAP-R104): the passes it runs, the context pictures the packet carries and how big pictures are tiled. A builder adds a subject by adding a row. The words an agent reads for each row live in the snap-critic skill's reference.md, under the same name.

tile.why: a vision read covers about 1.15 MP (long side ~1568 px), so a bigger picture is read again as 100% tiles after the whole frame (SNAP-R102)

location.label: a location version, every view side by side

settei.label: settei: a design reference of a place or prop

sheet.label: a Cast picture, sheet or turnaround

board.label: a board or still in a shot

cut.label: a video take in a shot

walk.label: a people-free walkthrough of a location: a video whose frames become plates (F-K06)

cut_pair.label: a cut pair: the last frame of one cut and the first of the next

still.label: a still with no known purpose

approval.why: the person approves unless a scene's or Book's note says "approval: critic" (SNAP-R107)
